messages:
Maria (Finance): Just got a PolarGrid invoice (INV-4589) for Feb, total $18,950 — no PO attached. @Sana can you take a look? I uploaded the PDF to AP.
Sana (Purchasing): On it. Vendor claims PO 2301-RED-97 but I can't find that number in Coupa. Can you paste the invoice excerpt or a screenshot?
Maria (Finance): Pasted excerpt from PDF and added file to AP (see link). Invoice shows: 
```
Invoice #: INV-4589
Vendor PO: 2301-RED-97
Dates: 2024-02-12 — 2024-02-20
Total: $18,950.00
Line items: High GPU nodes x48h = $12,300; Managed services = $6,350
```
Link: https://redwood-drive/restricted/INV-4589.pdf (AP file ID below)
invoice-bot: AP system: file uploaded. ID: AP-98765. Status: pending-approval. Reminder: attach GL and cost center to avoid auto-hold.
Alex (EngOps): We used PolarGrid for a load test those exact dates. Looks legit. Vendor's 'managed services' line seems inflated though — can we get a line-item breakdown? @Tim can you confirm the exact instances we spun up?
Tim (Eng Manager): Confirmed. Eng ran two p4d-like nodes for ~48h (Feb 12–14) and some smaller jobs Feb 18–20. My estimate from infra logs is ~$12k, not $18.9k. I'll approve once PO is resolved. We need the cost breakdown and the IPs/instance IDs for verification.
Sana (Purchasing): Options: (1) locate PO 2301-RED-97 in Coupa (vendor claim) — it might be a vendor-side number that maps to our PO 2301-RED-71; (2) create a retro PO (PO type: RETRO) with justification + Tim signature; (3) escalate to vendor for corrected invoice. Which path do we want?
Maria (Finance): I'll start an AP exception workflow now so payment is on hold. Adding preliminary GL: `5001-CloudInfra` and Cost center: `ENG-PLAT`. Sending vendor a request for full line-item CSV and instance IDs.
Alex (EngOps): I'll pull infra logs and post the instance IDs and timestamps here within the hour.
Tim (Eng Manager): I'll sign a retro PO if needed. Prefer vendor to remap to an existing PO though. If vendor insists on amount, I'll approve a partial holdback until we reconcile.
Sana (Purchasing): Copy. I'll draft a retro PO template: PO ID to be 2403-RETRO-2301 if we go that route. Maria, once Tim signs I'll link the PO to AP-98765.
Maria (Finance): Thanks — holding payment. Also vendor added a $450 late fee on the PDF; I'll contest that if usage dates line up with our records. Will update when Alex posts logs.
Alex (EngOps): Posted logs snippet and instance IDs: `i-0a1b2c3d (p4d-like) 2024-02-12T03:20Z — 2024-02-14T07:11Z`, `i-0f4e5d6c (smaller) 2024-02-18T12:05Z — 2024-02-20T02:00Z`. Matches vendor dates. Need vendor CSV to reconcile line rates.
Sana (Purchasing): Got it. Routing note: I'll request Price Quote (PQ) and vendor rate sheet before creating retro PO. If vendor won't provide, we'll do the retro PO + holdback process.
Tim (Eng Manager): I'll sign as soon as Maria attaches the justification doc. :thumbsup:
Maria (Finance): Added justification doc to AP file AP-98765. Notifying vendor we'll pause payment pending PO link or corrected invoice. If vendor pushes, we'll offer 7-day expedited with 10% holdback.
Sana (Purchasing): I'll follow up with vendor and update Coupa once we have either corrected invoice or signed retro PO. Closing loop here soon.
Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone — I'll keep this thread updated.
